s1.speaker: narrator
s1.text: A young samurai kneels before his master - an old monk who speaks softly and commands unquestioning loyalty.

s2.speaker: narrator
s2.text: The Master's face is always hidden. So are the faces of everyone who serves him.

s3.speaker: narrator
s3.text: (Speak to the Master.  WASD move - E interact - J attack - SHIFT/SPACE dash)
